observations.description: Passwords are BCrypt-encoded on driver creation.
GET /api/driver/name/{username} returns Driver entity (includes password field) and may expose password hashes.

recommendations.description: Adopt DB migrations and disable ddl-auto update in non-dev.
Stop returning entities containing password; use DTOs.

notes: DDL appears managed via Hibernate ddl-auto=update (see application.properties).
